evaluation.rationale: The notes capture almost all the information from the transcript but fail critically in synthesis and structure. They include both the initial, superseded plans and the final, corrected plans side-by-side in the Decisions and Action Items sections, creating direct contradictions (e.g., listing both Oct 16-19 and Oct 23-26 as the trip dates). The notes are also extremely bloated, repeating the same points multiple times across different sections and including nearly every irrelevant distractor from the casual conversation. This lack of filtering and resolution makes the notes highly confusing and unusable as a clear record of the meeting.
